description: This file contains cryptographic big number (BIGNUM) modular exponentiation functions, specifically implementing modular exponentiation and multiplication algorithms used in cryptographic computations, as part of the OpenSSL library.

methods.name: int BN_mod_mul(BIGNUM * ret,BIGNUM * a,BIGNUM * b,const BIGNUM * m,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Performs modular multiplication of two big numbers, with a slow but reliable implementation for cryptographic use.

methods.name: int BN_mod_exp(BIGNUM * r,BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * p,const BIGNUM * m,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation with different algorithm choices based on compile-time options, used in cryptographic computations.

methods.name: int BN_mod_exp_recp(BIGNUM * r,const BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * p,const BIGNUM * m,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Recursive, windowed modular exponentiation algorithm using pre-computations for efficient large exponent calculations.

methods.name: int BN_mod_exp_simple(BIGNUM * r,const BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * p,const BIGNUM * m,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Simple, straightforward implementation of modular exponentiation, used as fallback.
